DroidDeck · branch perf/close-the-gap · build 166f12a4

Performance mode, off and on

The same build, the same game files and the same settings on an AYANEO Pocket FIT (Adreno 750, 144 Hz screen). The only thing that changes between the two columns is the Performance mode switch under Mode settings > Frame rate.

Measured 2026-10-25. AIO Graphics Test 2.2.0: one standalone run per API, 15 seconds each, average FPS. DiRT Showdown: built-in benchmark, 1280×720, 8× MSAA. Sync esync, overlay off, no frame limit, device cooled between runs.

AIO bars share one scale (the highest result). The DiRT bar uses its own scale up to 110 fps. DiRT values are the average of every finished run on each side (6 off, 6 on).

What the switch changed, checked inside the running game

Off today's behaviour

  • DROIDDECK_WSI_BYPASS_CHECK_MS=0
  • WINE_OFFSCREEN_CHECK_MS=0
  • No swapchain override
  • Compositor hands frames back once per screen refresh (frames held)

On all four fixes

  • DROIDDECK_WSI_BYPASS_CHECK_MS=100
  • GAMESCOPE_WSI_ENSURE_MIN_IMAGE_COUNT=1
  • GAMESCOPE_WSI_MIN_IMAGE_COUNT=8
  • WINE_OFFSCREEN_CHECK_MS=100
  • gamescope log: minImageCount overridden … 8
  • Compositor hands frames back immediately (0 held)

The two cache settings are read by gamescope's WSI layer and by Wine. At 0 they check the window on every frame, as before; at 100 they reuse the answer for 100 ms. With the switch off, an alternating test of the files that would ship against the stock files showed no cost (D3D11 mean 1,167 vs 1,085 fps over four runs each).

DiRT Showdown benchmark

DiRT is mostly limited by the GPU (about 81 % busy), so it moves far less than AIO. Screens are taken mid-race; the small counter at the top right is DroidDeck's own frame counter.

Off

On

Follow-up, alternating off and on: off 4 of 4 runs finished (average 91.9 fps), on 4 of 4 finished (average 91.7 fps). The loading freeze did not come back. Across the whole day, 4 of 26 runs with unpaced frames never finished, against 0 of 7 paced runs. That is too few to tie it to the switch.

Numbers come from AIO's results files and DiRT's benchmark XML, not from reading the screenshots. All 16 AIO runs ended with zero FATAL lines in logcat. Performance mode is off by default; nothing here is merged or released yet.
